concerns.text: Task T009 uses a mocked `datasets.load_dataset` call to verify ingestion. FR-001 requires a real download and parsing of the datasets; using a mock weakens the functional requirement by not guaranteeing actual data retrieval.

Success Criterion SC-002 (measure reduction in dynamic‑execution cycles) is not addressed by any task. No task creates, computes, or validates the percentage of tasks skipped, leaving the criterion untested.

Success Criterion SC-004 (computational feasibility: runtime ≤6 h, memory ≤7 GB) is not verified. Profiling tasks T035a‑c generate logs but there is no test or verification step asserting that the pipeline stays within the GitHub Actions limits.
